name: stuck-order-import-tool
description: Windows PowerShell GUI tool for finding and batch-copying stuck/missing order KC XML files by order number.
summary: Helps operations staff quickly locate and gather multiple order XML files that are stuck or missing by entering order numbers. It scans a folder for matching files, shows which orders were found or not, and safely copies the needed files to a chosen output folder to speed up issue resolution. This removes the hassle of manually searching through files and reduces errors when handling order data.
